name: prudential_ratios
description: Child workflow. Single source of truth for Indonesian prudential ratios and their regulatory limits: KPMM/CAR with risk-profile minimum plus conservation/countercyclical/D-SIB buffers, CET1 and Tier 1, NPL gross & net with CKPN coverage, RIM (macroprudential intermediation ratio), LCR, NSFR, GWM, and BMPK (legal lending limit) for single borrowers, groups and related parties. Returns computed ratios, a classified breach list with the governing regulation, watch items approaching a limit, and whether the breach triggers mandatory OJK notification.

inputParameters.expression: (function(){var data={};try{data=JSON.parse($.payload)||{};}catch(e){data={};}var exposures=data.largeExposures||[];var num=function(v){return Number(v)||0;};var pct=function(n,d){return d>0?Math.round((n/d)*10000)/100:0;};var r2=function(x){return Math.round(x*100)/100;};var cet1=num($.cet1Capital);var at1=num($.at1Capital);var t2=num($.tier2Capital);var tier1=cet1+at1;var totalCapital=tier1+t2;var rwa=num($.rwaCredit)+num($.rwaMarket)+num($.rwaOperational);var car=pct(totalCapital,rwa);var cet1Ratio=pct(cet1,rwa);var tier1Ratio=pct(tier1,rwa);var profile=num($.riskProfile)||1;var minCar=(profile<=1)?8:(profile===2?9:(profile===3?10:11));var kbmi=num($.kbmi);var conservation=(kbmi>=3)?2.5:0;var ccb=num($.countercyclicalBufferPct);var dsibBucket=num($.dsibBucket);var dsibPct=(dsibBucket<=0)?0:(dsibBucket===1?1:(dsibBucket===2?1.5:(dsibBucket===3?2:2.5)));var requiredCar=r2(minCar+conservation+ccb+dsibPct);var capitalSurplus=Math.round(totalCapital-(requiredCar/100)*rwa);var loans=num($.totalLoans);var k3=num($.kol3Balance);var k4=num($.kol4Balance);var k5=num($.kol5Balance);var nplAmount=k3+k4+k5;var allowance=num($.lossAllowance);var nplGross=pct(nplAmount,loans);var nplNet=pct(Math.max(0,nplAmount-allowance),loans);var coverageRatio=nplAmount>0?pct(allowance,nplAmount):0;var dpk=num($.thirdPartyFunds);var secIssued=num($.securitiesIssued);var bonds=num($.corporateBondsHeld);var rim=pct(loans+bonds,dpk+secIssued);var lcr=pct(num($.hqla),num($.netCashOutflow30d));var nsfr=pct(num($.availableStableFunding),num($.requiredStableFunding));var gwmActual=num($.gwmRupiahPct);var gwmRequired=num($.gwmRequiredPct)||9;var breaches=[];var watch=[];var add=function(code,metric,actual,limit,severity,regulation,note){breaches.push({code:code,metric:metric,actual:actual,limit:limit,severity:severity,regulation:regulation,note:note});};var watchAdd=function(metric,actual,limit,note){watch.push({metric:metric,actual:actual,limit:limit,note:note});};if(rwa<=0){add('RWA_ZERO','ATMR',0,'>0','CRITICAL','POJK 11/POJK.03/2016','ATMR nol - data permodalan tidak lengkap');}else if(car<minCar){add('CAR_MIN','KPMM (CAR)',car,minCar,'CRITICAL','POJK 11/POJK.03/2016','KPMM di bawah rasio minimum untuk profil risiko '+profile);}else if(car<requiredCar){add('CAR_BUFFER','KPMM termasuk buffer',car,requiredCar,'HIGH','POJK 11/POJK.03/2016','Kekurangan buffer permodalan - pembatasan distribusi laba berlaku');}else if(car<requiredCar+1){watchAdd('KPMM (CAR)',car,requiredCar,'Marjin di atas kewajiban buffer kurang dari 1%');}if(rwa>0&&cet1Ratio<4.5){add('CET1_MIN','CET1',cet1Ratio,4.5,'CRITICAL','POJK 11/POJK.03/2016','CET1 di bawah 4,5%');}if(rwa>0&&tier1Ratio<6){add('TIER1_MIN','Modal Inti (Tier 1)',tier1Ratio,6,'CRITICAL','POJK 11/POJK.03/2016','Modal inti di bawah 6%');}if(nplNet>5){add('NPL_NET','NPL net',nplNet,5,'CRITICAL','POJK 40/POJK.03/2019','NPL net melampaui 5% - wajib rencana tindak lanjut');}if(nplGross>5){add('NPL_GROSS','NPL gross',nplGross,5,'MEDIUM','POJK 40/POJK.03/2019','NPL gross melampaui 5%');}else if(nplGross>4.5){watchAdd('NPL gross',nplGross,5,'Mendekati ambang 5%');}if(nplAmount>0&&coverageRatio<50){watchAdd('Coverage ratio CKPN',coverageRatio,50,'Pencadangan tipis terhadap kredit bermasalah');}if(lcr<100){add('LCR_MIN','LCR',lcr,100,'CRITICAL','POJK 42/POJK.03/2015','LCR di bawah 100% - wajib laporan segera ke OJK');}else if(lcr<110){watchAdd('LCR',lcr,100,'Mendekati batas 100%');}if(nsfr<100){add('NSFR_MIN','NSFR',nsfr,100,'HIGH','POJK 50/POJK.03/2017','NSFR di bawah 100%');}if(dpk+secIssued>0){if(rim<84){add('RIM_LOW','RIM',rim,'84-94','MEDIUM','PBI 21/12/PBI/2019','RIM di bawah target - disinsentif GWM berlaku');}else if(rim>94){add('RIM_HIGH','RIM',rim,'84-94','MEDIUM','PBI 21/12/PBI/2019','RIM di atas target - disinsentif GWM berlaku');}}if(gwmActual>0&&gwmActual<gwmRequired){add('GWM_MIN','GWM Rupiah',gwmActual,gwmRequired,'HIGH','PADG Bank Indonesia tentang GWM','Saldo giro di bawah kewajiban minimum');}var relatedTotal=0;var groups={};var exposureDetail=[];var largestPct=0;for(var i=0;i<exposures.length;i++){var ex=exposures[i]||{};var amt=num(ex.exposureIDR);var isRel=(ex.related===true||String(ex.related)==='true');var borrower=String(ex.borrower||('Debitur '+(i+1)));var grp=String(ex.group||'');if(isRel){relatedTotal+=amt;}if(grp){groups[grp]=(groups[grp]||0)+amt;}var p=pct(amt,totalCapital);if(p>largestPct){largestPct=p;}exposureDetail.push({borrower:borrower,group:grp,exposureIDR:amt,pctOfCapital:p,related:isRel});if(!isRel&&p>20){add('BMPK_SINGLE','BMPK debitur tunggal - '+borrower,p,20,'CRITICAL','POJK 32/POJK.03/2018','Pelampauan BMPK debitur tidak terkait');}else if(!isRel&&p>18){watchAdd('BMPK debitur tunggal - '+borrower,p,20,'Mendekati batas 20% dari modal');}}var relatedPartyPct=pct(relatedTotal,totalCapital);if(relatedTotal>0){if(relatedPartyPct>10){add('BMPK_RELATED','BMPK pihak terkait (agregat)',relatedPartyPct,10,'CRITICAL','POJK 32/POJK.03/2018','Pelampauan BMPK pihak terkait');}else if(relatedPartyPct>9){watchAdd('BMPK pihak terkait (agregat)',relatedPartyPct,10,'Mendekati batas 10% dari modal');}}for(var g in groups){if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(groups,g)){var gp=pct(groups[g],totalCapital);if(gp>25){add('BMPK_GROUP','BMPK kelompok peminjam - '+g,gp,25,'CRITICAL','POJK 32/POJK.03/2018','Pelampauan BMPK kelompok peminjam');}}}var rank={CRITICAL:4,HIGH:3,MEDIUM:2,LOW:1};var worst='NONE';var worstRank=0;var codes=[];var mandatory=false;for(var i=0;i<breaches.length;i++){var b=breaches[i];codes.push(b.code);if((rank[b.severity]||0)>worstRank){worstRank=rank[b.severity]||0;worst=b.severity;}if(b.code==='CAR_MIN'||b.code==='CET1_MIN'||b.code==='TIER1_MIN'||b.code==='LCR_MIN'||b.code==='NPL_NET'||b.code==='RWA_ZERO'||b.code.indexOf('BMPK')===0){mandatory=true;}}var complianceStatus;if(worst==='CRITICAL'){complianceStatus='BREACH_CRITICAL';}else if(worst==='HIGH'){complianceStatus='BREACH';}else if(worst==='MEDIUM'){complianceStatus='NON_COMPLIANT_MINOR';}else if(watch.length>0){complianceStatus='WATCH';}else{complianceStatus='COMPLIANT';}return {tier1Capital:tier1,totalCapital:totalCapital,totalRWA:rwa,car:car,cet1Ratio:cet1Ratio,tier1Ratio:tier1Ratio,minCarByProfile:minCar,capitalConservationBuffer:conservation,countercyclicalBuffer:ccb,dsibSurcharge:dsibPct,requiredCar:requiredCar,capitalSurplusIDR:capitalSurplus,nplAmount:nplAmount,nplGross:nplGross,nplNet:nplNet,coverageRatio:coverageRatio,rim:rim,lcr:lcr,nsfr:nsfr,gwmActual:gwmActual,gwmRequired:gwmRequired,relatedPartyPct:relatedPartyPct,largestExposurePct:largestPct,exposureDetail:exposureDetail,breaches:breaches,breachCodes:codes,watchItems:watch,breachCount:breaches.length,worstSeverity:worst,complianceStatus:complianceStatus,mandatoryNotification:mandatory,actionPlanRequired:(worst==='CRITICAL'||worst==='HIGH')};})();

inputParameters.queryExpression: {breachSummary:(if ((.breaches // [])|length)>0 then ((.breaches // [])|map(.metric+": "+(.actual|tostring)+" vs batas "+(.limit|tostring)+" ["+.severity+", "+.regulation+"]")|join("; ")) else "Tidak ada pelampauan" end),watchSummary:(if ((.watchItems // [])|length)>0 then ((.watchItems // [])|map(.metric+": "+(.actual|tostring)+" (batas "+(.limit|tostring)+") - "+.note)|join("; ")) else "Tidak ada" end),breachCodesText:(if ((.breachCodes // [])|length)>0 then ((.breachCodes // [])|join(", ")) else "None" end)}
